thread:
maria_csm: Heads up — ArcWave onboarding spiked ~3x in the last 24h. Renewal review in 10 days; want a short cost/QBR snapshot + enablement ask before we flag renewal risk. Billing alert attached.

billing-bot: [automated] high-usage alert for acct ArcWave. Metric: token_burn_rate (24h avg) = 52k/min. Estimated overage: $8.3k/day. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/arcwave/usage

raj_finops: Copy. Pulling 7d token burn and per-route breakdown now. Any idea which endpoints are hot?

ellie_enablement: /embed-bulk and /realtime-search are the culprits — they switched to large-embed-v2 for accuracy testing. Also running parallel batch jobs during ingest windows.

tim_research: Do they have prefix or KV caching enabled? If not, prefix caching + smaller quantized embed model will help a lot for batch ingestion.

maria_csm: They do NOT have caching. They pinned to large-embed-v2 because of 'recall' asks. I'll propose a quick A/B: large-embed-v2 for critical routes + small-embed-v1-quant for bulk indexing.

raj_finops: Forecast snippet (running quick local tool):
```
$ cost-forecast --acct ArcWave --window 7d --grp route
/estimate
  current: $4,200/day
  projected (no change): $12,400 next 7d
  projected (with cache + quant swap): ~$8,600 next 7d (~31% reduction)
```

sophie_sales: If we can show ~30% cut without perf regressions, we should push that in the renewal convo instead of offering deeper discounts.

ellie_enablement: I can run a 24h controlled test: enable prefix caching on /embed-bulk + route-level rate limit for retries, then switch index jobs to small-embed-v1-quant for one batch. Need arcwave approval and feature flag.

maria_csm: I'll ask the customer for permission right after this thread. Also requesting arcwave to pause non-prod ingest windows (>midnight) for 24h.

raj_finops: Action items I have: 1) attach per-route cost breakdown to QBR deck; 2) add a budget alert at $X/day + auto-notify CS; 3) prepare rollback plan if quality issues appear.

tim_research: I'll prepare a tiny eval harness comparing large-embed-v2 vs small-embed-v1-quant on their dev dataset (latency, recall delta). Should have results in ~6 hours.

sophie_sales: I'll draft renewal talking points: highlight projected savings and propose enablement session instead of discount.

maria_csm: Great. Summarizing next steps: Maria -> ask ArcWave for test permission; Ellie -> run 24h test + report; Tim -> eval harness; Raj -> cost breakdown + budget alert; Sophie -> renewal talk track. Meet async, share results in this thread. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [reminder scheduled] created budget alert rule "arcwave-qbr-threshold" at 110% baseline; notification -> #customer-success + maria_csm.

maria_csm: Thanks all — adding results to QBR deck once I have them.
